splits.policy: V3 retained unchanged. Original signature-even tuning selects thresholds. Previously reporting-only signature%4==1 source profiles validate selected risk bounds; signature%4==3 profiles report validation. Test excludes every source training/validation signature. Tuning/calibration/reporting-validation use first label-blind row per complete-198-feature signature; matched test retains all prior 53,386 records and reports unique-profile count.

policy.selection_method: Tuning maximum coverage under exploratory exact-binomial bound; one frozen threshold per exact evidence-count bucket independently checked on unique source-validation profiles. Disabled on failure, no retuning.
limitations: 90% target is a predeclared research engineering risk budget, not a medical standard or patient probability.
Clopper-Pearson bounds assume independent exchangeable source profiles and the same randomized sparse-evidence reporting scheme.
Source grouping, label ambiguity, nonrandom real reporting, Kenyan prevalence, missing classes and distribution shift preclude a clinical guarantee.
Same source can appear in different buckets; within each calibration bucket there is one masked view per unique complete source profile. Bonferroni does not require independence across buckets.
Prior reporting validation was used to inspect V3 but never fit it; a new deterministic source split isolates policy-bound checks and reporting validation.
Primary eligibility must be combined with clinical scope, free-text mapping ambiguity and warning-sign gates; uncertainty never rules out illness.

respiratory_scope.note: Fixed complaint-domain filter added independently of test outcomes; not triage or a disease exclusion rule. The original per-bucket bound checks concern pre-scope selection, not automatically the filtered subset. Scoped results below are empirical observations; no clinical or inherited selected-risk guarantee is claimed.
